executiveSummary: 4 tests regressed after the pivot date of 2026-10-30, with failure rates increasing significantly.
'NML510 - Trial Balance Report' failure rate rose from 40% to 67%, indicating a critical risk.
Both 'SIMS_TB_SCHOOL - XQuery Report' and 'File upload using SPC420' showed new failures at 17%.
Flaky behaviour was introduced in two tests, suggesting potential timing issues post-deployment.
These regressions may affect the reliability of financial reporting and processing.
Further investigation into the UAT environment may clarify the observed patterns.
Monitoring is recommended to assess the impact on operational efficiency during peak periods.
Addressing these issues promptly could restore confidence in the application’s performance.
